footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Arko: after $5.8M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 12.5% to $7.6B in 2025. Operating income rose 8.8% to $102M, a 1.3% margin.
Net income rose 12.6% to $17.0M, or $0.15 per share. Operating cash flow was $193M and free cash flow $65.3M, versus $108M; Arko returned $41.6M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Arko Corp. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
